name: Punctured Expansion Profile
definition: For $z\in\pi_eH$, $A\subseteq E\setminus\{e\}$, and $C\subseteq A$, let $\varepsilon_{H,e}(z,A;C)$ be the set of sides $i\in\{0,1\}$ on which the lift of $z^C$ belongs to $H$. It is a punctured expansion profile when the value at $A$ is empty and every proper $C\subsetneq A$ has a nonempty value. It is direct when one side occurs at every proper $C$, and switched otherwise.
codomain: Set-valued Boolean profiles on the face poset of a coordinate cube
parameters: A binary family H, a contracted coordinate e, a projected vertex z, and a candidate local-hole support A.
normalization: For a switched profile, partition the punctured cube into double fibres D and exclusive side sets Z_0 and Z_1.
comments: The profile is canonical relative to a selected contraction and projected local hole. Switched profiles record contraction holes assembled jointly from both sections.
